decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0913. Series context: trend strength 0.9146 and seasonal strength 0.1129; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.478); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 72.864.
